## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction: a pillar never accepts an edit or a save on a buffer that is not the open item's

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T21:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p1.** It is the same grade as objectui#11232, as the review suggests. A save writes one item's document into **another** item. That is data corruption through a public door (Studio on a writable package), measured on all three pillars **after** PR objectui#11265's fix.

**Why not blocked.** objectui#11232 is closed, and PR objectui#11265 merged at 2026-09-30T21:23Z. So `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has no in-flight claim against it.

**Direction.**
- **One rule, three members:** a pillar's buffer is bound to the item it was loaded for.
  - **During a load:** edits and explicit saves are refused or disabled (the enable switch and add-field included). Nothing is shown under the new item until its own document is in.
  - **Across a package switch:** Automations and Data drop the open item, and reload when it is not in the new package. `InterfacesPillar` is already keyed by package.
  - **The page inspector's non-editable branch** (about `:2180`) does not round-trip a buffer from another item. It is measured first, since it is read at source only.
- ⛔ No per-pillar variant of the rule. If PR objectui#11265's binding in `useDraftAutoSave` can carry it, extend that; the claim says why otherwise.
- **Pins:** the card's three measured sequences each give **zero** saves of the wrong document. A normal edit after the load completes saves once (the control).

| triage's direction (`5920456880`, p1): one rule, three members | the rule lives once, in `useDraftAutoSave`'s `owned()`: `since === target && loadedFor === target`. The timer, the flush and `sending` all go through it, and the pillars' `loaded` reads are its output, not a comparison of their own. All four callers (the Interfaces nav included) stamp `loadedFor` only where a load installs a buffer. No per-pillar variant |
| member 1, the load window | the page inspector, Automations (the enable switch) and Data (add-field, reorder, field count, badge) offer nothing and send nothing until the open item's own document is in. A refused reorder no longer rewrites another object's buffer |

The hook cannot see this case, and the state the remount drops is package-scoped. The one cost, an edit under 1.5 s old dropped without a prompt, is what PR objectui#11265 accepted for Interfaces, and it replaces a wrong-package write. The changeset states it |
| member 3, the non-editable round trip | the branch stamps `{}` as that leaf's and clears the dirty flag. It was measured first (1 save of `home` with body `{}` at the branch point), then pinned to zero saves |
| pins | six measured sequences, each red at the branch point `b4333ab8a3` and zero wrong-document saves at the head, each ending on a control that saves once. The ablations isolate each half (the U vs UA legs isolate the hook half) |
| the adapted objectui#11232 pin | its save readings are unchanged. PR objectui#11265's claim-target comparison now has no pin that fails on it alone. Read at source, it only gates the dirty-flag clear, over a window where `loadedFor` already refuses. Accepted as settled behaviour, as the record reasons |
| semver | `@object-ui/app-shell` patch: the hook and `DraftSend` are module-private, and no export, prop, schema or i18n key moves. `Clause-②: no` (the claim) is right |

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The Data pillar's "last saved" hint (`savedAt`) is not reset on an object switch, so it shows the previous object's time under the next one until a save. It is read at source, with no write and no measured reach. The pillar exposes `data-testid="data-saved-at"`, so one reading after an object switch would meet the filing gate → **Acceptance notes**.
- A failed load keeps the previous item's buffer, shows the error only and refuses every save on it. It is inside the rule, not pinned → **Acceptance notes**.

**Next:** objectui#11281 (the Automations rail's `FlowStatusDot`, same file) waited on this card, and becomes dispatchable once this lands.

## Landed: PR objectui#11296 merged as `5f2d9676c9`; closed `completed`

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ` · 2026-10-01T00:45Z.

- It merged at 2026-10-01T00:44:11Z. Verified by content: all 3 of its files on `origin/main` are blob-identical to the landing head `f5af9cb96`.
- What ships: a Studio pillar's buffer is bound to the item it was loaded for. One rule in `useDraftAutoSave` refuses any save of a buffer that is not the open item's, and the pillars offer nothing until that item's own document is in. Across a package switch, Data and Automations start fresh. The page inspector's non-editable branch no longer round-trips another item's buffer. The record is `5922218707` (at-tier PASS on the landing head), and the ACCEPT is `5922226492`.
- What stays, as Acceptance notes (no measured reach, not filed):
  - the Data pillar's "last saved" hint is not reset on an object switch;
  - a failed load keeps the previous item's buffer and refuses every save on it, which is inside the rule but not pinned.
- **Unblocked:** objectui#11281 (the Automations rail's `FlowStatusDot`, in the same file) waited on this card and is now dispatchable.
